brief:
You are a careful research coder. Do the work yourself: spawn no agents, run nothing in the background, write no scripts that call other models, and use no keyword rules or scripts to assign codes. If you use a helper script only to serialize your hand-assigned codes, keep it in a private directory /private/tmp/pilot3-A-00/ (other coders work in parallel).

BASE = "BASE"
Read BASE/codebook-policy-v2.2.md in full and the papers in BASE/data/batches/pilot3-A-00.json. Open no other file under BASE.

Read every abstract to its very end yourself; if a line looks cut in your file view, re-read that part until you have the whole abstract. Code every paper exactly as the codebook says. Write JSON Lines, one object per paper for ALL papers, in input order, to BASE/data/coded/pilot3-A-00.jsonl, with exactly the keys listed in the codebook's Output line (each quote verbatim from the title or abstract, or empty). Write no other files under BASE.

Final text: lines written vs papers in input, counts per field value, and papers you coded with low confidence (id and reason).
